_about: Herbalism manuals (docs/herbalism-revamp-plan.md §8.4): books that teach what herbs do.
Reading one takes hours of world time, teaches the properties it lists, and pays +5
herbalist mastery the first time (recorded per manual in `Actor.manuals_read`). Read by
rules/herbknowledge.py; bought like any good, at the alchemist's counter.
Original writing for Pathfinder GM (2026-10-02). Prices in gold, in the range of the
Core Rulebook's books and kits (a spellbook is 15 gp, a healer's kit 50 gp).
`teaches` names herbs by ingredient id and says which of each herb's properties the
book holds: "all", "benefits", "drawbacks", or a list of property keys ("p0"...).
The words are preferred over keys: keys are positions in an ingredient's effect list,
and a corrected corpus can move them; "drawbacks" still means the drawbacks after it
does. An id the corpus does not hold is skipped, never invented.
